Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::makeReservation(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		newReservation: Reserve
	precondition:
		let foundUser: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserId = uid) in
		let foundCopy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(c|c.Barcode = barcode and
		c.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE and
		c.IsReserved = false) in
		User.allInstance()->includes(foundUser) and
		BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(foundCopy)
	postcondition:
		let foundUser: User = User.allInstance()->any(u|u.UserID = uid),foundCopy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(b|b.Barcode = barcode) in
		Reserve.allInstance()->includes(newReservation) and
		newReservation.oclIsNew() and
		newReservation.ReservedUser = foundUser and
		newReservation.ReservedCopy = foundCopy and
		foundCopy.IsReserved = true and
		result = true
}
